edge_explainer.market_believes: Maximus is a melting government BPO: new business has dried up (two straight quarters of near-zero fresh awards), its two biggest contracts face decisions within months, AI will reprice its call-center and case-processing work, and the cheap multiple is a trap on next year's earnings.
edge_explainer.we_believe: Most of the price collapse is fear: current earnings and margins are strong and guided up, direct budget-cut damage is tiny so far, the balance sheet is sound with a large buyback, and the 2025 budget law legally mandates more paid Medicaid casework starting 2027. If new signings recover even partway, the stock re-rates 15-30%.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Coverage is nearly dead (no 2026 target updates while the stock halved), the seller base looks momentum/fear-driven, and the legislated 2027 redetermination volume increase is concrete, dated, and in nobody's numbers.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The award drought is real, started two years before the shutdown, and did NOT recover in the clean March quarter while every peer's did — the market may simply be reading that number correctly. Insiders bought nothing on the whole slide, and the work-requirement dollars are demonstrably flowing to Deloitte/Accenture, not Maximus. This is why we WAIT.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The ~Aug-6 print: quarterly signings above ~$1.3B validates 'delay not loss'; below ~$0.9B kills it. Then the CCO option decision ~Sep-10 and the VA exam-contract rebid timeline.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: If signings recover to ~1x and the stock still doesn't re-rate within two quarters, the market was never pricing awards — it was pricing AI-driven repricing of the per-transaction book, and the long mechanism is wrong.
edge_explainer.edge_type: time-arbitrage on a verifiable near-dated datapoint (awards print) in an under-covered, fear-derated name; NO edge claimed pre-print
edge_explainer.skeptic_reviewed: built post-drift-null and post-explainer-doctrine — no unverified mechanism claims
